title: The actual local normalization, tangent grading and normalized comparison data
statement: For a commutative local ring A with maximal ideal m, put B equal to the integral closure of A_red in its total quotient ring and E=B/mB [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure]. The structural maps are induced by A→A_red→B. The tangent grading is the image of each summand m^n/m^(n+1) in the actual direct-sum associated graded ring [def-weil-pbc-associated-graded-ring]. A chart comparison is normalized when every regular f∈m with mB=fB sends in_n(a)/in_1(f)^n to b mod mB whenever a=f^n b. Its naturality means the explicit graded and normalization maps of every local-ring isomorphism commute with the comparison. For a scheme point, Comparison records this normalized isomorphism over the residue field, uniqueness, the split/separable-quadratic alternative and its identification with the fibre of componentwise normalization [def-weil-pbc-reduced-normalization]. Completed branch algebras are the normalization of the actual geometric completed stalk modulo the extended original stalk maximal ideal; their scalar maps are induced by germs. GeometricBranches records the geometric pullback with both projections and cardinality two. All these are the pre-existing definitions of the parent module, relocated without changing their meaning; the ring-level IsNaturalIso factors the old naturality predicate definitionally.
